scope: Proposition 5.2 of the manuscript “Single-fold Diophantine representations” (preprints/Single-fold-Diophantine-representations-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 242 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fa6bf81ce22ef3a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that g : N → N has a complete single-fold graph and that there are fixed constants δ > 0 and u0 ∈ N, with u0 ≥ 4, such that δ(log u)2 < log g(u) < u log u (u ≥ u0). (14) Then the relation Pow(b, n, c) ⇐⇒ b ≥ 2 and c = bn (b, n, c ∈ N) has a complete single-fold representation. In particular, for each b ≥ 2 and n ∈ N, the output c and all auxiliary variables are jointly unique.
